title: Comprehensive Hedge Fund Strategy and Portfolio Management Framework
overview: A complete investment framework covering global portfolio construction, tax optimization, technical and fundamental analysis, options strategies, and risk management. This document synthesizes strategies for building and managing portfolios across US, Indian, and international markets with emphasis on liquidity-driven market dynamics, systematic capital deployment, and multi-asset diversification.
